editorial.description_en: Blue with most of its light gone, kept in the corpus as the floor of the group rather than as a colour anyone would reach for first.
editorial.description_ja: 光をうしなった、しずんだ青。

provenance.derivation: Editorial construction, not a measurement. Specified in OKLCh as L 0.224, C 0.066, h 264.0° and converted to canonical D65 XYZ by @irodora/color-spaces 0.1.0 (oklchToXyz), rounded to six decimal places. Re-derivable from this sentence alone.
provenance.editorialNotes: Name coined by Irodora: 沈み (shizumi, sinking) + 青 (ao, blue). It is not asserted to be a traditional Japanese colour name, and the hyphenated romaji marks it as a constructed compound (ADR-0065). "Sunken Blue" is an editorial decision about what communicates in English, not a literal translation of 沈青. Relations asserted from measured proximity under the current engine, not from a source: related is the three nearest in CIELAB — fuka-yoi at ΔE00 5.9, hoshi-nashi at ΔE00 6.8, shimo-yo at ΔE00 7.7. complementary is the entry nearest the opposite OKLCh hue (84°), within 22°. historicalVariants is empty: this entry makes no historical claim to vary from.
